question: All of the following are true about Nizatidine except

options.opa: It is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease
options.opd: It can also lead to tachycardia

analysis: Nizatidine is an H2 receptor antagonist used to treat peptic ulcer disease, similar to other drugs in its class. It is known for having high bioavailability, but not 100%. It does not enhance gastric emptying, which is more characteristic of prokinetic agents like metoclopramide. Tachycardia is a potential side effect of H2 blockers, including nizatidine, due to its effect on the cardiovascular system.
